narrative_prose: The First Forge groans under the magnetic strain, its aged copper bulkheads complaining as the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear sweeps across the nearby ferrofluid sea. Silas tightens his grip on the workbench, the air thick with the acrid scent of hot metal and ozone, a dry heat radiating through his heavy boots. With careful precision, he extends the heavy brass relay baton toward Hector, preparing to hand it off before the magnetic currents surge again.
summary: Silas braces against the magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear and passes the relay baton to Hector.
science_vegetable: Magnetohydrodynamic Kelvin-Helmholtz shear across the ferrofluid sea

active_location.macro_silhouette: The First Forge reverberates with the suppressed energy of a captured star, its brass and iron plating shifting under the immense pressure of the ferrofluid sea's magnetohydrodynamic shear. Coils of thick cable spark with static electricity, winding across stations laden with half-finished prototypes. A thick pall of acrid smoke billows from the primary vent, swirling in the dim amber glow as the dawn shift begins.
